detailed_description: Typing Speed Test measures words per minute (WPM), accuracy, correct characters, mistakes, and elapsed time directly in the browser. Choose an easy, medium, or hard prompt, then start typing in the text box; the page highlights each character as correct or incorrect while you work. When you finish the prompt, the result cards show your WPM, accuracy percentage, character totals, duration, and a simple skill rating. The test is intentionally lightweight and private: it uses local sample text, does not require an account, and does not upload what you type.
usage_steps: Select Easy, Medium, or Hard to choose the length and complexity of the prompt.
Click inside the typing box and begin entering the displayed text.
Watch the character highlighting to catch mistakes while you type.
Finish the prompt to see WPM, accuracy, correct characters, incorrect characters, duration, and rating.
Use New Text or Try Again to practice with another sample.
usage_examples: A student checks their WPM before an online writing exam.
A support agent practices accuracy on medium-length sentences before a shift.
A keyboard reviewer compares typing speed and mistake counts across two keyboard layouts.

faqs.question: How is WPM calculated?
faqs.answer: The test measures how long it takes to finish the prompt and converts the typed character count into a words-per-minute estimate.

faqs.question: Does the test upload what I type?
faqs.answer: No. The prompts and scoring run in the browser, and the tool does not require an account.

faqs.question: Can I choose the difficulty?
faqs.answer: Yes. Easy, Medium, and Hard choose different built-in prompts with different lengths and complexity.

faqs.question: What happens if I make mistakes?
faqs.answer: Characters are highlighted as you type, and the final result includes correct characters, incorrect characters, accuracy, duration, and WPM.
